train_log_loss_definition: sum of per-batch scalar losses (batch-mean MSE plus original OT regularization when active) divided by total batch prediction count
not_equivalent_to: overall row-weighted MSE; never compare its magnitude directly to evaluate() MSE
early_stopping_selection: validation IC strict improvement, original patience20 and epoch cap500 remain unchanged
reported_reference_MSE_source: original evaluate(pred) on public predictions; separate from logged train loss
